##### Project general facts

AG Aum is a contemporary residential building designed around comfort, elegance and smart living, blending a modern architectural character with a strong focus on everyday convenience. The building rises above basement parking levels and a ground floor and offers studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments with thoughtfully planned layouts. Every residence is a smart home, combining contemporary charm with a strong focus on everyday comfort for individuals, couples and families.

The amenity programme is centred on wellness, leisure and family life. Residents can enjoy a rooftop swimming pool with cabanas, a fully equipped gym and a quiet meditation area for relaxation. Families benefit from a children's playroom and comfortable family sitting areas, while an outdoor cinema and a barbecue area create inviting settings for gatherings and shared evenings with friends and neighbours. Together these spaces support a balanced, community-focused lifestyle within the building.

Interiors are finished in a modern style with high-quality materials and an emphasis on durability and clean design. Kitchens are fitted with appliances and offer a practical, contemporary setup for everyday cooking. An integrated smart home system brings convenient control of the home environment to every apartment. Residences are delivered with fitted kitchens, giving owners the flexibility to furnish the space to their own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubailand Residence Complex sits at the heart of Dubailand, an expansive district that brings together residential neighbourhoods, theme parks, a polo club, hotels and a wide variety of housing. Surrounding communities include Majan, Layan, Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club, Falcon City of Wonders, Living Legends and Villanova, giving residents a broad choice of services and leisure close to home.

Dubai Outlet Mall is only a short drive away, while Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road provide quick connections to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport. Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure and Dubai Miracle Garden are nearby, and schools, clinics and supermarkets are available across the surrounding neighbourhoods.

Dubailand Residence Complex is a freehold area that appeals to first-time buyers, young families and investors seeking accessible entry points within a well-connected part of the city. Steady rental demand from professionals working across Dubai supports attractive yields. Continued development of neighbouring communities adds to the long-term appeal of the location.
